items.summary: Create reusable Google AdSense React components that can be used across the app, including (a) a component that ensures the AdSense script is loaded only once per page load using the provided script tag, and (b) a reusable ad slot component that renders an <ins class="adsbygoogle"> element with configurable props (e.g., ad client, slot id, format, responsive) and triggers adsbygoogle rendering safely.

Render the AdSense components globally across the app in the main content area on all pages/sections, so that ads are inserted within the <main> content flow (not in the HTML <head>). Ensure this global insertion applies to both the standard section-based UI and the referral redirect route.
